purpose: Adds role-based static HTML cache variants for logged-in users, with an enable/disable toggle and role selector in the admin dashboard. Logged-in users receive cached pages keyed by role group instead of falling through to full WordPress boot each request.
riskRationale: All identified issues have been resolved: role hash is salted with wp_salt(), logic is centralised into Util::get_role_hash() and Util::is_cache_eligible_for_current_user(), logout cookie cleanup and admin/AJAX guards are in place, WooCommerce regex is anchored, and the 500-file cap in delete_role_variant_files() has been removed.
breakingChanges: New advanced-cache.php layout extracts wppo_serve_cache_file() helper — sites with customized drop-ins will be overwritten on plugin upgrade (existing DROPIN_MARKER guard prevents overwriting foreign drop-ins)
New wppo_role_hash cookie may increase request size for logged-in users by ~32 bytes
Old cache variants (non-role-hashed) remain valid for visitors — no breaking change for existing cached pages

text: Role-based cache variant system that integrates cleanly with the existing caching stack. All security, maintainability, and correctness issues identified during review have been resolved: cookie forgery hardened with wp_salt(), hash logic centralised, logout/request guards added, role gate applied consistently across all optimisation hooks, role-less user collision prevented, and the 500-file cap removed.

reasoning: All review findings addressed. Role hash uses wp_salt() to prevent cookie forgery. Duplicated logic centralised into Util::get_role_hash() and Util::is_cache_eligible_for_current_user(). Cookie cleared on logout, guarded on admin/AJAX/REST. Google Fonts handler now respects loggedInCacheRoles. Role-less logged-in users cannot collide with anonymous cache. 500-file cap removed from delete_role_variant_files(). Unused $wppo_salt removed from generated advanced-cache.php.

message: delete_role_variant_files() is correctly called alongside every existing delete_cache_files() call in invalidate_dynamic_static_html() and clear_cache(), ensuring cache invalidation always removes role-specific files alongside standard cache files.
Extracting wppo_serve_cache_file() into a shared helper eliminates duplicated ETag/Last-Modified/304-handling logic.
The wppo_role_hash cookie is sanitized with a strict hex-only regex filter before being used to construct the file path.
Util::get_role_hash() and Util::is_cache_eligible_for_current_user() provide centralised, consistent logic for role hashing and eligibility checks across Cache, Main, and Google_Fonts classes.
Conditional rendering of role checkboxes only when the toggle is enabled prevents confusion when the feature is off.
Role hash was unsalted (plain md5 of role names). Fixed by including wp_salt() in Util::get_role_hash().
Role hash logic was duplicated between Cache and Main. Fixed by centralising into Util::get_role_hash().
wppo_role_hash cookie never cleared on logout. Fixed by adding clear_role_hash_cookie() hooked to wp_logout.
Cookie set on every init including admin/AJAX/REST. Fixed by adding is_admin() || wp_doing_ajax() || REST_REQUEST guards.
Regex used case-insensitive flag unnecessarily. Fixed by removing /i flag.
WooCommerce exclusion regex matched substrings. Fixed by anchoring with ^/(?:cart|checkout|my-account)(?:/|$)#i.
should_optimise_for_logged_in() ignored loggedInCacheRoles. Fixed by delegating to Util::is_cache_eligible_for_current_user().
is_cache_allowed_for_current_user() allowed role-less logged-in users to collide with anonymous cache. Fixed by moving empty($user->roles) check before empty($allowed_roles) shortcut.
delete_role_variant_files() had a 500-file cap that could leave stale files. Fixed by removing the cap.
process_style_tag() only checked enableLoggedInCache, not loggedInCacheRoles. Fixed by delegating to Util::is_cache_eligible_for_current_user().
$wppo_salt was embedded in generated advanced-cache.php but never used. Fixed by removing the unused variable.
Mutating frozen wppoSettings.settings.cache_settings after apiRequest.js already froze the object. Fixed by removing the redundant mutation.
CSS combining now runs for eligible logged-in users but uses shared index.css. Non-issue: combined CSS is role-independent (minified stylesheet bundle).
resolution: no change needed — output is identical regardless of role
